providers.name: rice-edit
providers.summary: Use when a symbol rename, file move or code navigation needs a plan-verified edit.
intents: semantic refactor with a verified plan
go to definition and find references
providers.notes: Go, TypeScript, Rust, Java and Dart. Flow: rice-edit plan semantic (rename, move) or plan structural, then plan freeze, apply and verify; navigate, symbols and diagnostics read code. Structural rewrites are experimental and pin ast-grep 0.50.0. rice-edit help lists the verbs.

providers.name: gopls
providers.summary: Use when renaming, extracting or inlining Go code with the Go language server.
providers.notes: CLI verbs: gopls rename -w file.go:#offset NewName, gopls codeaction (extract, inline), references, definition, check, workspace_symbol. rice-edit drives the same server with a verified plan.

providers.name: rust-analyzer
providers.summary: Use when renaming Rust symbols or running structural search and replace on Rust code.
intents: structural search and replace in rust
providers.notes: rust-analyzer ssr '$a.foo($b) ==>> bar($a, $b)' rewrites and rust-analyzer search finds by the same pattern; rename goes through the language server, for example with rice-edit.

providers.name: typescript-language-server
providers.summary: Use when an editor or rice-edit needs a TypeScript or JavaScript language server.
providers.notes: A server only (typescript-language-server --stdio); drive it from an editor or through rice-edit, not directly from a shell.

providers.name: ast-grep
providers.summary: Use when searching or rewriting code by syntax tree pattern instead of plain text.
intents: rewrite code by syntax tree pattern
providers.notes: ast-grep run -p PATTERN -r REWRITE previews; -U applies; --json for machine output. rice-edit pins ast-grep 0.50.0 for its structural plans; some installs also link it as sg.

providers.name: jscpd
providers.summary: Use when finding duplicated code within or across repositories, with JSON or SARIF.
intents: duplication report as json or sarif
providers.notes: v5 is a self-contained Rust binary (no Node at runtime). jscpd repo-a repo-b --skip-local keeps only clones that cross the scan roots; --reporters json or sarif.

providers.name: ccusage
providers.summary: Use when reporting local agent token usage and cost by day, week, month or session.
providers.notes: Reads the local logs of 18 agent CLIs. ccusage daily, weekly, monthly or session; add --json for machine output and --offline to skip the pricing fetch. Also runs as bunx ccusage.

providers.name: osv-scanner
providers.summary: Use when scanning dependencies for known vulnerabilities or disallowed licenses.
intents: vulnerability report as sarif or json
audit a repository for vulnerable packages
providers.notes: osv-scanner scan source -r . for a checkout; --licenses ALLOWLIST checks licenses; --format json, sarif or cyclonedx.

providers.name: syft
providers.summary: Use when generating an SBOM for a directory, archive or container image.
intents: list packages in a container image
providers.notes: syft dir:. -o spdx-json or -o cyclonedx-json; feed the SBOM to osv-scanner or trivy.

providers.name: trivy
providers.summary: Use when scanning images, filesystems or repositories for vulnerabilities and licenses.
intents: vulnerability scan with a shared server
providers.notes: trivy fs --scanners vuln,license . for a checkout.

providers.name: renovate
providers.summary: Use when keeping pinned dependency and tool versions current through update PRs.
providers.notes: Self-hosted: run it as a scheduled job or service, not per edit. It also keeps vendored rice-agent releases current in consuming repositories.

providers.name: shellcheck
providers.summary: Use when linting shell scripts for quoting, portability and correctness bugs.
providers.notes: shellcheck -x script.sh follows sourced files; -f json1 or gcc for machine output.
